text:
Nobody Gets Left Behind | A Lilo & Stitch Twisted Tale Animation
What if keeping the family together meant leaving Earth behind and Nani had to prove herself worthy? A reimagined darker story of Disney’s Lilo & Stitch told through silhouette and animation. 

Inspired by The New York Times Best-Selling Series, A Twisted Tale, available wherever books are sold. 

Production by: Wild Comet Media, Lucy Animation Studio, Formidable Studio, Animales del Sur.
